description: Test suite for ToolResultTextFormatter, providing unit tests that validate text formatting, JSON summarization, error message handling, and handling of unknown payloads.

classes.name: ToolResultTextFormatterTests
classes.description: Test suite struct containing multiple test cases for the ToolResultTextFormatter functionalities.

methods.name: leavesPlainTextUntouched
methods.description: Tests that plain text input remains unchanged after formatting.

methods.name: summarizesNodesListJSON
methods.description: Tests JSON data with a list of nodes to verify summarization and display of node details.

methods.name: summarizesErrorJSONAndDropsAgentPrefix
methods.description: Tests error JSON input to ensure error messages are properly extracted, and extraneous info is dropped.

methods.name: suppressesUnknownStructuredPayload
methods.description: Validates that unrelated or unrecognized JSON payloads result in empty output.
